verdict.rationale: Fivetran's core model is recurring scheduled work. Connectors sync automatically on intervals, down to 1-minute syncs on paid plans, and transformations run after connection syncs or on a set schedule. A community report also describes syncing as very reliable. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring sync frequency or cron-style schedules, evidence that schedules can be set via the REST API or MCP server for AI-native workflows, and support for scheduling general workflows beyond syncs and transformations.
